candidate_searches: NASA detector imagery selected for L02. Smithsonian slide-rule/thermostat candidates had inaccessible images or insufficient verified image-rights evidence and were not used. NIST digital thermometer page contextual evidence considered; existing verified calibration image selected for continuity connection.
interactive_decision: Considered moving centre point and branch controls. Static side-by-side diagrams make all relevant cases simultaneously available; the one-hour learner-controlled Python experiment supplies useful manipulation and comparison. No additional animation/video would justify added controls or workload for this unit. This is a selection decision after media planning, not a general exemption.
review: All new figure images rendered and inspected with captions; structural media audit passes for each new lesson. No private OU image or text reproduced.
